messages.content:
Risk: Violence
Description: Promoting or describing physical harm to individuals or groups. This includes depictions of assault, self-harm, or creation of a hostile environment through threats or intimidation.
Concern: None
Policy: Self Harm

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/Law: law — rule recognized by some community as regulating the behavior of its members and that it may enforce through the imposition of penalties [found by 4/6 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/GoalsAndObjectives/Objectives/Aim: aim — intention specifying a desired direction, condition, or situation toward which an agent's actions are directed, without requiring precise scope or measurable criteria [found by 4/6 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 5/6 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Reference: reference — source that may be used to ascertain, interpret, or understand something [found by 5/6 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001147: Act of Violence — A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force. [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Measuring, Act of Military Force, Act of Prediction

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the description of the risk, as it involves communication that can create a hostile environment through threats or intimidation.
This class is directly relevant as it encompasses the physical harm to individuals or groups, which is central to the risk description.
